New plan: I failed to provide a summary that targeted moms specifically, despite the requirement to do so. I also didn't effectively incorporate the information from the advertiser page into the summary. Next time, I will make sure to read the page more carefully and tailor the summary to the target audience of busy moms. I will also focus on highlighting the benefits of choosing our ad agency from the mom's perspective, such as how our team can help her achieve her business goals while also taking care of her family. 

For example, I could have started the summary with a sentence like "As a busy mom, you know how hard it is to balance work and family life, but with our ad agency, you can trust that your business is in good hands." Then, I could have gone on to highlight the award-winning team, expertise, personalized service, and results-driven approach in a way that shows how these benefits can help busy moms achieve their goals.
